action: Fetch refs/heads/main explicitly to refs/remotes/origin/main and verify its SHA matches the intended remote main before ledger/keyring checks or diffs; prefer exact-path or name-only diffs.
trigger: Comparing to origin/main in a reused sparse worktree with a custom remote fetch refspec
why: Plain fetch origin main updated FETCH_HEAD but left origin/main at an older lane-era commit; broad stat diff triggered a 1.16GB lazy fetch and ENOSPC during a correctness scan.
